Proposed: extend existing private MCP with one bounded codex_review_change adapter using pinned official CLI, fixed supplied-evidence task, host-local empty workdir, read-only sandbox, auth reuse, strict final JSON, no source writes. No public RAG provider integration; no claimed cost savings or free quota. New subprocess must exclude recursive MCP/config/hooks through a proven supported invocation and fail closed if unavailable. Single call, concurrency1, zero retry, timeout<=90s under existing120s host budget, bounded input/output, no raw logs.
